value: U.S. Department of Energy, Advanced Manufacturing Office; prepared by Energetics Incorporated (2012). Understanding Manufacturing Energy and Carbon Footprints. Companion document to the 2006 MECS Manufacturing Energy and Carbon Footprints (October 2012), 5 pp.

Methodology companion to the 2006 MECS footprint diagrams (doe_2012_001); no technology parameters. Reader's guide to the footprint diagrams: what each box and flow means, and how primary, offsite and onsite energy relate. Copied 2026-10-08 from the modeller's N:\CIMS\Sources\Technologies\EIA MECS\2006 folder (download name understanding_energy_footprints_2012.pdf).
